comment: What :media ships that is read as a resource, declared by glob rather than
`media/view/media.css`, the four widgets' stylesheet, which :core reads out
of the package module-info opens to it. Declared by hand here, beside the
file `:media:foreignMetadata` generates from the bindings into
goldberry-media/: that one owns the foreign calls and the natives jar's
glob, and two files at one path would collide in the jar.
The showcase traces a run that opens the Audio and Video tabs, so its image
had the stylesheet anyway -- the luck ADR-0453 says not to build on.
And the one class `GpuVideo` looks up by name to learn whether :gpu is
here (ADR-0484): unregistered, an image would always answer no, and draw
video on the CPU. An image built without :gpu has no such class, and the
